title: v1 beach campfire
about: The campfire drum dance's fire on the v2 world's beach (coordinator, 2026-10-14). Accepting adds it to the painter's document; Save writes web/data/world-map.json. Until it is placed, lib/game/campfireSite.ts picks open sand by the beach landmark.

objects.note: On the beach, by the beach landmark: the fire, the sitting ring and the dance ring round it.
